units: order limitPrice, order amount, withdraw amount, transfer amount, builderFeeRate, and approve-builder fee rates are raw 6-decimal fixed-point integers
REST and websocket auth timestamps are Unix nanoseconds encoded as decimal strings
notes.signature_format: EIP-712 signatures are 65 bytes encoded as hex with 0x prefix in r||s||v order; signing.Sign normalizes v to 27 or 28.
signing_roles: wallet signs Register, ApproveBuilder, Withdraw, and Transfer
signing_key and other_signing_key sign Order and SignKey vectors
backend_quirks: domains are explicit in this file and do not depend on EXCHANGE_ENV
Register verification accepts both Register(address key,uint256 expiry) and the legacy hashed-key Register(bytes32 key,uint256 expiry) variant

Register, Withdraw, and Transfer verification uses VerifyPersonalSignature, so the backend accepts either the direct EIP-712 digest signature or a personal_sign signature over the 32-byte EIP-712 digest
Withdraw message data is bytes32 keccak256(raw data); empty raw data uses keccak256("")
REST HMAC validation signs r.URL.Path only; the query string is not included in the canonical string
websocket signed auth uses method "ws" and signs the operation name as the path

hmac.canonical_rule: canonical string is key,timestamp_ns,method,path,body; REST uses r.URL.Path without query, websocket uses method ws and operation name as path
hmac.algorithm: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical string using the API secret, encoded as lowercase hex without 0x

rest.description: GET request where query parameters are present on the request target but excluded from the signed path
POST request with compact JSON body signed byte-for-byte
DELETE request with empty body and query excluded from signed path

request-level websocket auth object on a create_order operation
one-off signed op:"auth" payload; backend signs an empty body for this mode
